question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct option is "entertaining".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• **entertaining **- interesting and amusing.
 
• **tiresome **- that makes you angry or bored.
 
• **inhibited **- to prevent something or make something happen more slowly.
 
• **detrimental **- dangerous.
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that sport is the most interesting and amusing pastimes ever.
 
• So, **'**entertaining' is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• The rest of the options are contextually incorrect.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer. 

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Allegiance to one’s favourite team is something that sports fans (1) __develop__* *over a period of time. They are so attached to their favourite teams that they could display (2) __varied__ emotions, not just during the course of the match, but much after the actual event is over. This phenomenon, (3) __though__* *common across the globe, is more seen in countries like Brazil, India, the US and even the UK, where the favourite sport may not be the same in each of these nations. In spite of this craze and hysteria, sport has (4) __come__ a long way. It is accepted as one of the world’s most **(5)** __**entertaining**__* *pastimes ever.*
